SELECT sou_project.PROJECT_ID, sou_project.PROCESS_CONFIG_ID, sou_project.SOU_NO, sou_project.SOU_NAME, sou_project.CURRENT_ROUND, sou_project.PUBLISH_SCOPE, sou_project.PROJECT_STATUS, inq_project.EXT_PROJECT_STATUS, sou_order.ORDER_NO, sou_order.ORDER_STATUS, sou_project.SIGN_UP_END_TIME, sou_project.ORDER_START_TIME, sou_project.ORDER_END_TIME, sou_project.PUBLISH_TIME, sou_project.ALLOW_WITHDRAW, sou_project.CREATED_BY, sou_order.CREATED_FULL_NAME, sou_order.LAST_UPDATED_FULL_NAME FROM scc_sou_order_item order_item LEFT JOIN scc_sou_order sou_order on order_item.ORDER_ID = sou_order.ORDER_ID LEFT JOIN scc_sou_project sou_project on order_item.PROJECT_ID = sou_project.PROJECT_ID LEFT JOIN scc_npm_sou_purinq_project inq_project on inq_project.PROJECT_ID = order_item.PROJECT_ID LEFT JOIN scc_sou_item sou_item on order_item.SOU_ITEM_ID = sou_item.SOU_ITEM_ID WHERE 1 = 1 AND sou_project.SOU_TYPE = 'ext_pur_inq' AND order_item.ORDER_STATUS IN ('SUBMISSION', 'CANCEL')
AND order_item.VENDOR_ID = #{vendorId}
AND exists ( SELECT * from scc_sou_vendor vendor WHERE vendor.PROJECT_ID = order_item.PROJECT_ID AND vendor.VENDOR_ID = order_item.VENDOR_ID AND vendor.VENDOR_NAME LIKE concat('%', concat(#{vendorName}, '%')) )
AND sou_project.SOU_NO like concat('%', concat(#{souNo}, '%'))
AND sou_item.ITEM_CODE like concat('%', concat(#{itemCode}, '%'))
AND sou_item.ITEM_DESC like concat('%', concat(#{itemDesc}, '%'))
AND ( sou_project.CURRENT_ROUND > order_item.ROUND OR inq_project.EXT_PROJECT_STATUS IN ('EVALUATING', 'PRICE_END') )
order by project.SOU_NO desc, sou_item.SORT_INDEX asc
